title: Sonnet work package (delegation contract)
description: Spec §3.2. A Sonnet must never receive "implement this part of the plan"; it receives a self-contained, verifiable contract that an agent with no prior context can execute.

objective.description: 1. What this package must achieve, in one paragraph.

scope.description: 2. Perimeter. `owned_files` is the exclusive write lock for spec §15 concurrency control.

interfaces.description: 3. Signatures, behaviours and contracts the result must satisfy.

constraints.description: 4. Rules and prohibitions, including project conventions.

acceptance_criteria.description: 6. Ids of the design criteria this package satisfies.

out_of_scope.description: 7. Explicitly excluded work, to prevent scope drift.

report_format.description: 8. Required shape of the returned report (agent-report.schema.json).

parallel_safe.description: True only when owned_files is disjoint from every concurrent package (spec §15).
